summary: Extensions add reconstructable history, safe effect mediation, policy gates, and replay-based validation.

items.text: Persist an append-only transition journal and derive current state as a projection, retaining actor, policy version, attempt, evidence, and reason for every accepted or rejected command.
Route all consequential effects through an outbox or command gateway carrying process ID, attempt token, idempotency key, expected version, deadline, and compensation reference.
Attach policy-as-code guards to transitions and reserve human approval for risk-sensitive state changes such as external publication, production mutation, or non-compensable actions.
Replay recorded histories against new state-machine and policy versions in shadow mode to find stuck paths, invalid transitions, retry storms, and changed verdict semantics before rollout.
